Commentary.Commentary: Back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Saim Ayub and Babar Azam to open. Benjamin Lister to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

One can't write a lot for a side which has been bowled out for below 100. It was a forgetful show with the bat. No batter managed to cross the 20-run mark and now their bowlers face a massive task ahead. They need a Herculean effort if they are to pull off a miracle. Pakistan on the other hand, should chase this down. Join us for the second half in a bit.

End of a dominating first half by the hosts! Their bowlers were on point after they elected to bowl. The pacers began brilliantly. Both Amir and Shaheen gave them early wickets and Pakistan just did not look back after that. Abrar Ahmed impressed and so did Shadab Khan. A combined effort has seen them take total control of this game.

OUT! BOWLED! That's Shaheen Afridi for you. A pin-point yorker, angling on middle and swings away. Benjamin Lister is late to get his bat down and it crashes the stumps. THE KIWIS END WITH 90 on the board.

TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and ELECTED TO BOWL!

It is rain which came out on top in the first one but the weather forecast for the second game is really good and we expect a full one. Pakistan are yet again massive favourites as they're playing at home and New Zealand have an inexperienced squad. However, it is a chance for the youngsters in the New Zealand squad to prove their mettle. Who will take a 1-0 lead? We will find out.
... MATCH DAY ...

New Zealand's tour of Pakistan continues with the 2nd of the 5-match T20I series to be played between these two sides at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, Rawalpindi. The first game of this series was a washout with just 2 balls bowled in the game. Babar-led Pakistan will be looking to gain some momentum and test themselves against the Kiwis ahead of the mega ICC event. Pakistan handed out debuts to three players in the first game but they were not allowed to showcase their talent due to a washout but they would be looking for an opportunity again this time around. Usman Khan has opted to return to Pakistan at the expense of his permanent spot in the U.A.E. side and he will be itching more than anybody else to stake a claim in the Pakistan batting line-up for that squad that will be traveling to the ICC T20 Cricket World Cup. The form of Mohammad Amir and Imad Wasim will be looked at as well with both the veterans opting out of retirement. There is a lot for Pakistan to sort out and a series as such against a good side like New Zealand will surely help them going ahead. New Zealand on the other hand have not travelled with their best side with a lot of players playing in the Indian T20 League. Those who have traveled would be looking at this as an audition for the upcoming mega event and would look to perform to their best ability and make a mark for themselves. The side has a lot of good players but they are lacking International exposure and to play against a quality side like Pakistan at their full strength would surely serve good to them. Tim Robinson did get a taste of what it feels like to face a quality bowler as he was knocked over in just 2 deliveries that Shaheen Afridi bowled in the first game. Both sides will look to get answers to a lot of questions with squad selections and build up some positive momentum ahead of the ICC T20 Cricket World Cup. Will the hosts ease past the not so experienced visitors or do we have a surprise around the horizon? We shall find out when these sides collide.
